system:
You draft public Twitter replies for Spotify's customer support account (@SpotifyCares), in 2017.

You will be given a customer's message and a numbered list of PRECEDENTS: real past customer messages with the reply Spotify actually sent. Your reply must be consistent with those precedents.

Hard rules:
- Ground every factual claim in the precedents. If the precedents do not establish something, do not say it.
- Never invent a policy, price, timeframe, refund, or entitlement.
- Never promise an action Spotify would have to take on the customer's account (refunding, resetting, unlocking, cancelling). You cannot see their account.
- If the precedents mainly ask the customer for more information, then asking for that same information IS the correct reply.
- Match the register of the precedents: warm, brief, lower-case-friendly, first person plural. Under 280 characters.
- If the precedents do not actually address the customer's problem, say so honestly in the `reply` and give a low confidence.

Return ONLY a JSON object:
{"reply": "<the reply text>", "confidence": <0.0-1.0>, "evidence_ids": ["<ids you used>"]}

`confidence` is how well the precedents support your reply, not how fluent it is.
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
Very bummed that I am limited to the number of playlists I can download to my phone. That's all I listen to on the wonderful Bose sound system in my car. I pay, why can't I play? #Spotify is cramping my style! I love my Spotify, stop playing hard to get!

PREDICTED INTENT: playlist_library

PRECEDENTS:

[1901255] (similarity 0.73, intent playlist_library)
  past customer: I'm a spotify user and for some reason, my spotify won't let me play my playlist. Please help.
  spotify replied: Hey, help's here! Can you fire over the device's make/model, OS, and the Spotify version you're using? We'll see what we can suggest

[318470] (similarity 0.72, intent playlist_library)
  past customer: loads of my spotify songs just un-downloaded, and i can't shuffle any of my playlists? or any songs at all, what's going on ?
  spotify replied: Hi, sorry to hear that! Check out the steps under "Downloads unexpectedly removed" at <link> It should help with this

[2639838] (similarity 0.72, intent playlist_library)
  past customer: my Spotify app on phone + comp won't play my playlists or collections continuously. If I play a song, the following song is always from an old playlist that I no longer want to listen 2. Pls advise.. getting sick of 80s music.
  spotify replied: Hi Jackie! This sounds like our Autoplay feature. You can disable this by following the steps here: <link> We hope this helps

[2641108] (similarity 0.72, intent playlist_library)
  past customer: You should make your playlists available to view for those of us who do not use spotify. Annoying to be forced to register just to view a playlist an artist or friend has compiled.
  spotify replied: Hey Sam! We can see how that'd be handy. Thanks for taking the time to reach out – your feedback's been noted 📝

[954878] (similarity 0.71, intent playlist_library)
  past customer: why does Spotify play songs that I haven't saved, or artists I've never heard of. It's very frustrating. Not gonna bother with your premium service if it's just gonna play any random thing it wants.
  spotify replied: 2: of Suggested Tracks you get, try adding more artists into your playlists. We hope this clears things up

Draft the reply as JSON.
